summary: In Genesis 3:15, שׁוּף describes the blows exchanged by the woman's offspring and the serpent. Each clause names the part of the body struck.

senses.definition: To deliver a blow to an opponent.

evidence.note: In יְשׁוּפְךָ רֹאשׁ the suffix identifies the serpent as the object and רֹאשׁ locates the blow. The answering clause uses the same verb for the serpent's strike at the heel.
